name: delivery
description: The host-neutral delivery engine: two flow-* staged procedures named for what changes — flow-code for every change to the code, flow-spec for the devbook folders — run over a closed list of phase-* skills, and the pull-request lane, sequenced by the flow-runner agent, which resolves each phase's agent, skill, model and effort, with human gates a repository adds but never removes, and a run surface resolved from the live tool list so none is a normal outcome. Bindings, phases, policy, and gates are declared per repository in .devbook/config.json.
